Her research focuses on Medical Humanities, Spatial Studies while other areas of interests are Gender Studies and Trauma Literature. Specialisation and interest: English Literature Publications and Career Highlights "GENDERED TRAUMA IN THE SHADOWS OF TERRORISM: A CRITICAL ANALYSIS OF GROWING UP BIN LADEN AND BOMBSHELL", JOURNAL OF ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE. 10. 45-51. 10.54513/JOELL.2023.10408. Papers Presented at Conferences Presented a paper titled, "Medical Intricacies and Ecological Insights: An In Depth Analysis of Kaala Paani on Netflix" at the International Conference - Health and Humanities: Exploring Uncharted Terrains in Literary Paradigms, organised by Kristu Jayanti College, Bengaluru on the 25th of January, 2024. Presented a paper titled, "Navigating the Past and Future: Memory, Cognition, and Sustainabilty in Disney's Moana" at the Third Annual International Conference of the Indian Network for Memory Studies- Memory, Security and Sustainability hosted by IIT Madras on the 16th of September, 2024. Presented a paper titled, "Destigmatizing Addiction: Alcoholism as a Disease in Vellam: The Essential Drink(2021)" at the International Conference on Evolving Perspectivesin Humanities and Social Sciences organised by Kalaisalingam Academy of Research and Education, Tamil Nadu from February 20 to February 21, 2025.
